label: human-browser
task: Load the homepage and doc pages like a person, following a stale link to a 404.
mechanism: scripts/browse.ts drives a real Chromium engine through the proxy; it fetches CSS/JS/image assets and sends browser headers (UA 'HeadlessChrome/149…', sec-fetch-mode navigate/no-cors).
notes: ~58% asset ratio — the inverse of the agents and crawler. A real browser engine, not hand-driven; hand-driven human sessions can be added later with the same proxy. Reproduce with `scripts/capture-session.sh <out> ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/browse.ts http://localhost:4000`.
